{{Short description|Russian mathematician (1927–2000)}}
'''Fridrikh Israilevich Karpelevich''' ({{langx|ru|Фридрих Израилевич Карпелевич}}; 2 October 1927 &ndash; 5 July 2000) was a Russian mathematician known for his work on [[semisimple Lie algebra]]s, [[geometry]], and [[probability theory]].<ref>See {{harvtxt|Dynkin|Gelfand|Gindikin|2001}}, {{harvtxt|Dynkin|2003}}</ref> Together with [[Simon Gindikin]], he discovered the [[Gindikin–Karpelevich formula]].<ref>The original paper is {{harvtxt|Gindikin|Karpelevič|1962}}. See {{harvtxt|Knapp|2003}} for a review.</ref>
